page_title: MON 3-2 REN | Monaco v Rennes 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Radoslaw Majecki makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Mohamed Meite (Rennes) after a cross from the side.
90+4' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+4' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Brice Samba scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
90+2' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

89' Mika Biereth (Monaco) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
88' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Brice Samba, who pulls off a decent save!
87' Jeremy Stinat shows the yellow card to Hans Hateboer (Rennes) for a heavy challenge.
85' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
85' Jorge Sampaoli prepares a substitution. Ludovic Blas is replaced by Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
82' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes).
81' Adi Hutter has decided to substitute Lamine Camara and he is replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
81' Substitution. Aleksandr Golovin will be replaced by Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco).
80' Lamine Camara (Monaco) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
80' Lucas Michal (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Monaco will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Lucas Michal (Monaco) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went to the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba made an easy save.
75' The foul by Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jeremy Stinat.
74' Substitution. Christian Mawissa Elebi makes way for Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
74' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Lucas Michal (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
73' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) gets a yellow card.
72' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
70' A yellow card for a tackle by Christopher Wooh (Rennes). Jeremy Stinat doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
70' A substitution has been made. Mahamadou Nagida goes off and Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) comes on.
69' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle.
67' 3 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) was set free in the area by Seko Fofana and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
65' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Amine Gouiri (Rennes), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
64' Vanderson (Monaco) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
64' Lamine Camara (Monaco) launches a cross from the corner, but Brice Samba is alert to thwart the effort.
63' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jeremy Stinat ignores the protests.
62' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul after Amine Gouiri (Rennes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
58' Denis Zakaria is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco).
57' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
56' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Maghnes Akliouche tees up Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Brice Samba.
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Amine Gouiri (Rennes) is replacing Jordan James.

52' 2 - 1 Goal! Lamine Camara puts Mika Biereth (Monaco) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully low into the middle of the goal. 2:1.
51' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
51' Mika Biereth (Monaco) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Brice Samba.
50' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
49' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) commits a foul and Jeremy Stinat immediately signals a free kick.
47' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
46' Referee Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.

45+1' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Radoslaw Majecki has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
45' The linesman makes the right call and Rennes will have a corner.
45' The ball is cleared after Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Radoslaw Majecki is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
42' Jordan James (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Lamine Camara (Monaco) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
35' Half-chance! Takumi Minamino (Monaco) plays a pass into the box, but Brice Samba reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
32' Mika Biereth (Monaco) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
31' Dangerous play by Christopher Wooh (Rennes). Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Mika Biereth (Monaco) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
29' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jeremy Stinat stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
26' The ball possession is 61:39.
23' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
21' Lamine Camara (Monaco) makes a strong challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul.
20' A cross into the box picks out Ludovic Blas (Rennes), who steps inside his marker and fizzes a shot high over the bar.
18' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Vanderson (Monaco) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
17' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
15' 1 - 0 What a goal that is! Vanderson sends a brilliant cross into the box and Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 1:0.
14' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Brice Samba made a easy save.
12' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.

10' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Brice Samba was alert and the score remained the same. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Christopher Wooh (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
4' A spell of possession for Monaco in an attempt to control the game.
1' The match has just started.
Rennes will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will supervise the game today.
